notes: Analysis is highly faithful to the enacted Public Law 119-34 (H.R. 1316) source; 0 material issues. All substantive prose fields (summary, brief, top_lines[], sections[].items[], changes, likelihoodReason, underreported[], gaps[]) decomposed and receipt-backed against the source; no divisions[] on this bill. Minor rows: (1) sponsor name and (2) cosponsor count in likelihoodReason are congress.gov metadata not present in the bill source (structural, rubric-permitted, unverifiable from source); (3) the featured floor quote cannot be verified — the source has no Congressional Record text and no referencedSources are registered; (4) one minor omission — the section detail's element list drops '(A) reason for control, if applicable' (though versionChanges surfaces it). One benign attribution nuance (SUPPORTED, kept): the analysis labels Supplement No. 1 to part 740 as 'Export Administration Regulations' while the source calls it 'title 15, Code of Federal Regulations'; part 740 is within the EAR, so equivalent. versionChanges[] was NOT audited: it compares the Introduced-in-House text to the enacted text, and only the enacted Public Law source is available here, so those cross-version claims are not source-verifiable in this pass.
